description: Second step of the USDC-gas path. Pass back the draft from prepare_transaction unchanged. For usdc_path, add permit_signature (EIP-712 signature of the returned permit). For either path, add authorization_signature (EIP-7702) if prepare asked for one. Returns the final user operation plus its EIP-712 typed data and hash for you to sign. Nothing is sent.

authorization_signature.description: Only on first use on the chain: the EIP-7702 authorisation signature, as 65-byte hex or {r, s, yParity}.

permit_signature.description: usdc_path only: 65-byte hex signature of usdc_path.sign.permit (typed data or its digest).

name: build_user_operation
